title: The validator that dirtied the tree it validated
description: The pre-commit test runner opened every run with two find -exec chmod +x passes over tests/ and src/hooks, so a tracked script sitting at mode 100644 came out of the run dirty and the mutation rode into an unrelated commit, exactly what dirtied tests/test-ascii-density-ratchet.sh on lane fix-4070 (#4084). The runner now opens with a read-only exec-bit preflight over git ls-files, fails closed with the per-file repair command, and never chmods; seven tracked scripts are fixed to 100755 in the same PR; and tests/ci/test-run-all-tests-no-mutation.sh drives the pre-commit path in a throwaway repo, asserting git status --porcelain stays empty and a stripped bit fails loudly with no silent repair. Flip the tracked mode and the runner version in the page and read the porcelain.
